_comment: Fields below are graded BY HAND after collection. null = not yet filled. Objective fields (integrity, tokens, cost, time, self-verification, build) filled from the Codex rollout; quality marks from the visual pass.
_tokenUsageNote: From the Codex CLI rollout (total_token_usage): input 1,744,237 (all-in, incl. cached 1,613,312; fresh 130,925), output 25,763 (incl. 2,522 reasoning), total 1,770,000. Matches the prior codex run's convention: 'input' is all-in, 'cached' is the cache-read portion, total = input + output.
_estimatedCostNote: GPT-5.6 Terra list pricing (July 2026): $2.50/M input, $15.00/M output, cached input reads 90% cheaper = $0.25/M (OpenAI/aipricing.guru: Terra $2.50). fresh 130,925 @ $2.50/M = $0.33 + cache reads 1,613,312 @ $0.25/M = $0.40 + output 25,763 @ $15.00/M = $0.39 -> ~$1.12. Cumulative input well under any per-request 272k large-context threshold, so no multiplier.
_timeTakenNote: From the Codex rollout wall span (extract-session-codex.mjs): 2026-07-09T22:32:32Z start, 579s (~9m39s).
_selfVerification: Did the harness review the running app in a browser (from the run log)? pass = reviewed and succeeded · partial = tried but failed · fail = no attempt. Note what it actually did.
selfVerificationNotes: pass/pass — genuine browser review. It read the harness's control-in-app-browser skill doc, then drove a Playwright-backed in-app browser: served dist/ with `python3 -m http.server 4173`, opened a tab to http://localhost:4173/, waited for domcontentloaded, and captured DOM/accessibility snapshots. It queried `tab.dev.logs({levels:['error','warn']})` TWICE (after load and after reload) — both returned `[]` (no console errors/warnings). It took ~35 screenshots (emitImage), read `#countReadout` innerText = '42,033 DISPLAYED' (confirming the 42k asteroids actually rendered), and evaluated layout bounding boxes of #space/.topbar/.console. consoleReview = pass (reviewed, clean), displayReview = pass (reviewed rendered output + verified data render). Best self-verification of any run collected so far.
_grade: Marks: pass | good | partial | poor | fail | na | null(ungraded). See RUBRIC.md. Score is computed by pnpm compile.
